Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you
were involved in while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please describe what you were doing right before the collision.
A: I was driving in the right lane on the highway and wanted to move over to the left lane to get ready for my exit. I
checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and started to merge.
Q: Did you use your turn signal before you changed lanes?
A: I believe I did. I flipped it on a few seconds before I started moving.
Q: What happened next?
A: As I was partway over, I felt a hard bump on the side of my car. The other vehicle was in the left lane, and it had
come up beside me. We scraped along each other for a moment before both of us stopped.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not clearly. I glanced at the mirror and didn't see anything rihgt next to me, but I might have missed it in my blind
spot.
Q: Were you injured in the collision?
A: Yes. My lower back started hurting that same day. It's a dull, tight ache that gets worse when I sit for long periods
or bend over. I went to get checked out afterward.
Q: Have you received any treatment since the collision?
A: I've seen a doctor and I'm doing some physical therapy. The doctor said it looks like a back strain.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my back feeling normal again.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
